title: Fitness + is only available in “select” countries
body: Are the select countries the only markets with Apple users? What’s the logic behind this selective offerings? Does Apple sell their products at significantly lower prices in this countries it offers less of their services? As if they are more important customers than others. Please make the offers equally available to all users globally. Why is this still a thing?
